docs.title: Lunaar
docs.text:
Lunaar is an open-source web proxy and online gaming platform designed for speed, privacy, and fun—all in your browser.

Github Link

Live Site Link

Self Hosting

docs.title: 🚀 Features
docs.text:
• Modern UI: Clean, responsive, and easy to use.
  • Fast Built-in Proxy: Browse securely and bypass restrictions.
  • 350+ Built-in Games: Play a huge library of games instantly.
  • Theme Support: Light, dark, and custom themes.
  • AI Chatbot: Get instant help or just chat for fun.
  • Inspect Element: Developer tools at your fingertips.
  • Tab Cloaker: Hide your activity with cloakjs.
  • Panic Key: Instantly hide Lunaar with a single keystroke.
  • And much more!

docs.title: Lunaar Lite
docs.text: Lunaar Lite is the newest and Recommended way to deploy your own lunaar and the easiest to deploy.

docs.title: Hosting a Static HTML Site
docs.text: Lunaar Lite generates static HTML sites that can be hosted on various platforms. Here are some popular methods:

docs.title: GitHub Pages (Best Method)
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository at https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite
  2. Go to your forked repository on GitHub.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Pages.
  4. Select the branch (main) and the folder (/ for root).
  5. Your site will be available at https://<username>.github.io/lunaar-lite after 1 - 10 mins.

Warning

Regularly press the sync button on your forked repo to ensure the games keep working and to get the latest updates.

docs.title: Netlify
docs.text:
1. Fork the Repo https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite
  2. Sign up for a Netlify account.
  3. Connect the Repository you just forked.
  4. Netlify will build and deploy automatically.
  5. Get a custom domain if desired.

docs.title: Vercel
docs.text:
1. Fork the Repo https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite
  2. Create a Vercel account.
  3. Connect the Repository you just forked.
  4. Vercel handles deployment automatically.
  5. Supports custom domains and preview deployments.

docs.title: GitLab Pages
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository at https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite
  2. Create a new project on GitLab.
  3. Import your forked repository from GitHub into the GitLab project (GitLab > New project > Import project > GitHub).
  4. In your GitLab project, go to Settings > Pages.
  5. Ensure Pages is enabled; it should automatically deploy static sites.
  6. Your site will be available at https://<username>.gitlab.io/<project-name>.

docs.title: Cloudflare Pages
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository at https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite
  2. Sign up or log in to Cloudflare Pages.
  3. Click "Create a project" and connect your GitHub account.
  4. Select your forked repository from the list.
  5. Configure build settings if needed (for static sites, defaults usually work).
  6. Click "Save and Deploy".
  7. Your site will be available at a Cloudflare Pages URL, with fast global CDN included.

docs.title: Render
docs.text:
1. Fork the repository at https://github.com/parcoil/lunaar-lite and use your forked repo
  2. Create a free account.
  3. Choose "Static Site" and connect your Git repo
  4. Deploy with one click.

docs.title: Other Options
docs.text: • Surge: A simple hosting service. Install Surge CLI and run surge in your project folder.

docs.title: Running Locally
docs.text: You can run Lunaar locally or on a server by following these steps:

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Node.js 22
  • PNPM
  • (Optional) Groq API key for Luna AI

docs.title: Step 1: Clone the Repository
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/Parcoil/lunaar.org
cd lunaar.org

docs.title: Step 1.5: Install PNPM (if not already installed)
docs.text:
If you already have PNPM installed, skip to Step 2.

npm install -g pnpm@latest

docs.title: Step 2: Install Dependencies
docs.text: pnpm install

docs.title: Step 3: Start Lunaar
docs.text: pnpm start

docs.title: 1. Get a Groq API Key
docs.text:
1. Visit Groq Console
  2. Sign up or log in to your account
  3. Navigate to API Keys section
  4. Create a new API key
  5. Copy the API key (it starts with gsk_)

docs.title: 2. Configure Environment Variables
docs.text:
Create a .env file in your project root with:

GROQ_API_KEY=your_actual_groq_api_key_here

docs.title: Updating Lunaar
docs.text:
To keep Lunaar up to date (highly recommended to run once a week):

cd lunaar.org
git pull
